cohort: 260 healthy parturients with FGM and 260 without FGM in the first stage of labor at the Federal Teaching Hospital Abakaliki between January 1, 2013, and December 31, 2013
finding: Parturients with FGM had increased odds of perineal tear and episiotomy, but FGM did not significantly influence mode of delivery or neonatal Apgar scores.
mod_finding: The study found that while mode of delivery was not significantly influenced by FGM, parturients with FGM had increased odds of perineal tear and episiotomy.
